title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, and Inserting Therein Certain New Items
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, and Inserting Therein Certain New Items

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 14 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1493_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (m), page one hundred forty of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven is amended to read as follows:
"(m) Hinatuan High School Building- Repair and improvement ₱2,000.00"

Item thirty-six, page six hundred thirty, items sixty and sixty-one, page six hundred thirty-two, and item sixty-five, page six hundred thirty-three of the same Act, are amended to read as follows:
"36. Catangnan Barrio School Building, General Luna- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00 "60. Maglambing Barrio School Building, Hinatuan— Repair and improvement 1,000.00 "61. Port Lamon Barrio School Building, Hinatuan- Repair and improvement 1,000.00 "65. Bahi Barrio School Building, Lianga— Repair and improvement 1,000.00"

Between item sixty-five and item sixty-six, page six hundred thirty-three of the same Act, the following new item is inserted:
"65-A. Gamut Barrio School Building, Lianga- Repair and improvement 1,000.00

Items seventy-five and seventy-six, page six hun¬dred thirty-three, and item one hundred ten, page six thirty-six, of the same Act, are amended to read as follows:
"75. Hamindang Barrio School Building, Lingig- Repair and improvement 2,000.00 "76. Anibungan Barrio School Building, Lingig- Repair and improvement 1,000.00 "110. San Isidro Barrio School Building, Marihatag- Repair and improvement 1,000.00"

Between item one hundred ten and item one hundred eleven, page six hundred thirty-six, of the same Act, the following new item is inserted:
"110-A. Sto. Niño Barrio School Building, Marihatag- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00"

Item one hundred fifteen, page six hundred thirty-six of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
"115. Marihatag School Shop Building, Marihatag— Repair improvement 1,000.00"

Between item one hundred fifteen and item one hundred sixteen, page six hundred thirty-six of the same Act, the following new items are inserted:
"115-A. Marihatag Home Economics Building, Marihatag— Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00 "115-B. Marihatag Central School Quonset hut, Marihatag- Repair and improvement 1,000.00"

Item one hundred twenty-three, page six hundred thirty-seven, item one hundred thirty-six, page six hundred thirty-eight, item one hundred fifty-nine, page six hundred forty, and item one hundred seventy-two, page six hundred forty-one, of the same Act, are amended to read as follows:
"123. Mat-i Barrio School Building, Surigao- Repair and improvement ₱2,000.00 "136. Libuac Barrio School Building, Surigao— Repair and improvement 2,000.00 "159. Balite Barrio School Building, Surigao— Repair and improvement 2,000.00 "172. Mambahin Barrio School Building, Cortes— Repair and improvement 1,000.00"

Between item one hundred seventy-two and item one hundred seventy-three, page six hundred forty-one of the same Act, the following new item is inserted:
"172-A. Madrelino Primary School Building, Cortez- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00"

Item one hundred seventy-four, page six hun-dred forty-one of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
"174. Sta. Filomena Barrio School Building, Tandag- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00"

Between item one hundred seventy-four and item one hundred seventy-five, page six hundred forty-one, of the same Act, the following new item is inserted:
"174-A. Sotil Sitio School Building, Carmen, Tandag- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00

Item one hundred seventy-six, page six hundred forty-one of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
"176. Tag-anongan Barrio School Building, Cortes- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00

Between item one hundred seventy-six and item one hundred seventy-seven, page six hundred forty-one, the same Act, the following new item is inserted:
"176-A. Cortes Home Economics School Building, Cortes- Repair and improvement ₱1,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 16, 1956.
